Ruffer Llp increased its stake in Disney Walt Co (DIS) by 6.9% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Ruffer Llp bought 184,474 shares as the company’s stock declined 6.93% with the market. The institutional investor held 2.86M shares of the television services company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $281.39M, up from 2.68M at the end of the previous reported quarter. Ruffer Llp who had been investing in Disney Walt Co for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $154.98 billion market cap company. The stock increased 1.47% or $1.51 during the last trading session, reaching $103.98. About 7.09 million shares traded. The Walt Disney Company (NYSE:DIS) has declined 4.73% since June 10, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 17.30% the S&P500.
Ruffer Llp, which manages about $2.04 billion US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Jpmorgan Chase & Co (NYSE:JPM) by 745,443 shares to 51,630 shares, valued at $5.55M in 2018Q1, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in Ultrapar Participacoes S A (NYSE:UGP) by 738,929 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 849,141 shares, and cut its stake in Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL).
